split_policy: Fixed before experimentation: 15 dev questions (Q01-Q15) and 5 test questions (Q16-Q20). Includes 5 metadata filter questions (3 dev, 2 test).

questions.question: What is the maximum lifetime of an access token in the Cloud Platform?
questions.expected_answer: Access tokens expire strictly after 45 minutes, except for automated batch workers which may request a 120-minute lease.
questions.evidence_quote: Access tokens expire strictly after 45 minutes, except for automated batch workers which may request a 120-minute lease.

questions.question: How often do master encryption keys need to be rotated?
questions.expected_answer: All master key material in the vault must undergo automatic cryptographic rotation every 90 calendar days.
questions.evidence_quote: All master key material in the vault must undergo automatic cryptographic rotation every 90 calendar days.

questions.question: Under what condition is SSH root login permitted on bastion nodes?
questions.expected_answer: Direct SSH root login is strictly prohibited on all bastion nodes unless break-glass emergency mode is activated by two security officers.
questions.evidence_quote: Direct SSH root login is strictly prohibited on all bastion nodes unless break-glass emergency mode is activated by two security officers.

questions.question: According to the security section, what is the default timeout threshold for external gateway requests?
questions.expected_answer: In the security gateway layer, the default request timeout threshold is configured to 12 seconds per upstream call.
questions.evidence_quote: In the security gateway layer, the default request timeout threshold is configured to 12 seconds per upstream call.

questions.question: What is the maximum payload size allowed on the internal Kafka event bus?
questions.expected_answer: Messages published to the internal Kafka event bus must not exceed 4 megabytes after compression.
questions.evidence_quote: Messages published to the internal Kafka event bus must not exceed 4 megabytes after compression.

questions.question: How many read replicas are provisioned for each primary PostgreSQL shard?
questions.expected_answer: Each primary PostgreSQL database shard is paired with 3 synchronous and asynchronous read replicas across availability zones.
questions.evidence_quote: Each primary PostgreSQL database shard is paired with 3 synchronous and asynchronous read replicas across availability zones.

questions.question: When does the API gateway bypass the Redis distributed cache?
questions.expected_answer: The API gateway serves responses from Redis cache by default, except when the client header X-Bypass-Cache is signed by an internal service.
questions.evidence_quote: The API gateway serves responses from Redis cache by default, except when the client header X-Bypass-Cache is signed by an internal service.

questions.question: In the deployment section, what is the default timeout threshold for health checks during rollout?
questions.expected_answer: During canary deployment rollouts, the default request timeout threshold for container readiness probes is 40 seconds.
questions.evidence_quote: During canary deployment rollouts, the default request timeout threshold for container readiness probes is 40 seconds.

questions.question: What error percentage triggers an automatic rollback during a canary release?
questions.expected_answer: An automatic canary rollback is triggered immediately if the HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 1.5 percent over a 5-minute window.
questions.evidence_quote: An automatic canary rollback is triggered immediately if the HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 1.5 percent over a 5-minute window.

questions.question: How long are deprecated container images kept in the registry before garbage collection?
questions.expected_answer: Deprecated Docker container images are retained in the private registry for 60 days prior to automated garbage collection.
questions.evidence_quote: Deprecated Docker container images are retained in the private registry for 60 days prior to automated garbage collection.

questions.question: What is the maximum acknowledgement time for a Severity-1 incident page?
questions.expected_answer: On-call engineers must acknowledge any Severity-1 pager alert within 10 minutes of dispatch.
questions.evidence_quote: On-call engineers must acknowledge any Severity-1 pager alert within 10 minutes of dispatch.

questions.question: When are database schema migrations allowed during peak business hours?
questions.expected_answer: Production database schema migrations are blocked between 08:00 and 20:00 UTC unless the change is purely additive and non-locking.
questions.evidence_quote: Production database schema migrations are blocked between 08:00 and 20:00 UTC unless the change is purely additive and non-locking.

questions.question: Within the operations section, what is the retention period for system audit records?
questions.expected_answer: For operational telemetry and runtime debugging, system audit records are retained in hot storage for 180 days.
questions.evidence_quote: For operational telemetry and runtime debugging, system audit records are retained in hot storage for 180 days.

questions.question: How quickly must a confirmed personal data breach be reported to the regulator?
questions.expected_answer: Any confirmed personal data breach must be reported to the external supervisory authority within 72 hours of discovery.
questions.evidence_quote: Any confirmed personal data breach must be reported to the external supervisory authority within 72 hours of discovery.

questions.question: How long does the system take to purge user records after an account deletion request?
questions.expected_answer: Upon receiving a verified right-to-erasure request, all personally identifiable user records are permanently purged within 14 days.
questions.evidence_quote: Upon receiving a verified right-to-erasure request, all personally identifiable user records are permanently purged within 14 days.

questions.question: How many consecutive failed login attempts lock a developer account?
questions.expected_answer: A developer account is locked for 30 minutes after 6 consecutive failed multi-factor authentication attempts.
questions.evidence_quote: A developer account is locked for 30 minutes after 6 consecutive failed multi-factor authentication attempts.

questions.question: What is the target recovery point objective (RPO) for tier-1 transactional databases?
questions.expected_answer: Tier-1 transactional databases maintain continuous WAL shipping to guarantee a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of under 30 seconds.
questions.evidence_quote: Tier-1 transactional databases maintain continuous WAL shipping to guarantee a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of under 30 seconds.

questions.question: Under what exception can a hotfix bypass the staging soak period?
questions.expected_answer: Every release must complete a 24-hour staging soak period, except for zero-day security hotfixes approved by the VP of Engineering.
questions.evidence_quote: Every release must complete a 24-hour staging soak period, except for zero-day security hotfixes approved by the VP of Engineering.

questions.question: According to the compliance section, what is the mandatory retention period for system audit records?
questions.expected_answer: To satisfy financial and statutory regulations, system audit records are archived in immutable cold storage for 7 years.
questions.evidence_quote: To satisfy financial and statutory regulations, system audit records are archived in immutable cold storage for 7 years.

questions.question: In the operations section, what is the default timeout threshold for background health jobs?
questions.expected_answer: In routine cluster operations, the default request timeout threshold for background maintenance jobs is 300 seconds.
questions.evidence_quote: In routine cluster operations, the default request timeout threshold for background maintenance jobs is 300 seconds.
